title: This Cool Lava Planet Has an Atmosphere - Nautilus
gist: A study in The Astrophysical Journal Letters finds that HD 3167 b, a lava 'super-Earth' about four times Earth's mass with a one-day orbit, has an atmosphere, making it the fifth lava planet known to have one.

insights.claim: HD 3167 b is a rocky lava 'super-Earth' with roughly four times Earth's mass that orbits a star slightly smaller than the Sun, completing a year in about one Earth day.
insights.speaker: Jake Currie
insights.so_what: Extreme close-in orbits make such planets observable targets for atmospheric studies even though they are not habitable.

insights.claim: A new study published in The Astrophysical Journal Letters reports that HD 3167 b has an atmosphere, which the author describes as surprising.

insights.so_what: Adds to evidence that hot rocky planets can retain atmospheres, informing which exoplanets telescopes should prioritize.

insights.so_what: Lava worlds may be analogues for early Earth, offering a window into how rocky planet atmospheres form.
